name: Tote
details: Tote watches what goes in the cart and quietly figures out who owes what — no spreadsheets, no awkward Venmo math. Shared lists sync in real time across a household, split by whoever tossed it in, and settle up at the end of the week. Built for roommates who like each other and want to keep it that way.

name: Shotcall
details: Shotcall is push-to-talk built around the way squads actually play — ephemeral rooms that spin up when you queue and disappear when you're done, low-latency audio that ducks under callouts, and a pings layer that turns 'left, left, LEFT' into something the whole team can see. No servers to manage, no stale channels to prune.

name: Koshi
subheader: Your cozy corner of the internet
details: Koshi is a small, warm social space designed to feel like a late-night café rather than a feed. No metrics, no infinite scroll — just a handful of people, ambient presence, and rooms you actually want to linger in. A study in doing less, and doing it softly.

name: Grapevine
subheader: Turn your network into your pipeline
details: Grapevine turns warm introductions into a measurable sales channel. It maps who in your extended network can open which doors, scores the paths by strength and recency, and drafts the intro ask for you. The result: a pipeline that compounds off relationships you already have instead of cold outreach that burns them.

name: Viridian
subheader: We build the AI your business needs
details: Viridian is a studio that ships production AI for teams without an ML org of their own — retrieval systems, agents, and evals wired into the tools they already use. Less demo-ware, more durable systems: shipped, measured, and maintained.

name: PartnerHire
subheader: Curated experts. Human guidance. Better AI.
details: PartnerHire helps teams find the right AI expert, faster. Instead of sifting through cold marketplaces, you get a curated shortlist and a human in the loop to guide scoping, vetting, and the match — so the specialist you bring on actually moves the work forward.

name: Trace
details: Trace is a resale marketplace for the piece you can't stop thinking about. List, bid, buy — a cleaner way to move sought-after fashion between people, with provenance you can trust and demand you can see before you commit.
